name: Maker Channel
description: People making, building, repairing, inventing, and occasionally destroying fascinating things: a 12-hour, 12-show lineup (Adam Savage's Tested, DIY Perks, This Old Tony, GreatScott!, Integza, Ivan Miranda, Jeremy Fielding, Wintergatan, Clickspring, Blondihacks, my mechanics, colinfurze) in one-hour slots, repeating every 12 hours.
